title: closebook grading
description: The coach's grading of answers the learner exported from the HTML lesson page. The learner pastes it into the page's import box; `progress_tool.py apply-grading` applies the same block to a progress file. Each grade replaces the result of the attempt with the same id and marks it `coach_graded`.

lesson_id.description: The lesson the answers came from; the page refuses grades for another lesson.

attempt_id.description: The **ID** shown next to the answer in the exported answers.

feedback.description: One or two sentences for the learner: what was right, what was missing. Stored as the attempt's `note`.
